plugins.name: unmassk-pentesting
plugins.description: Pentesting — offensive + defensive security engagement toolkit. Method-spine skill (recon-first loop, three-hypotheses, blind validation, scope contract) plus 29 technique skills across web, network/system, cloud, specialized (LLM/blockchain/crypto/RE/mobile/social), blue-team (DFIR/SAST/cloud-defense/firewall), and CTF/bug-bounty. Techniques lifted from communitytools by Transilience AI (MIT).

plugins.name: unmassk-humanizer
plugins.description: Humanize written text so it stops reading as AI, in English + Spanish, without flattening the author's voice. One skill: 3-pass rewrite (structure/vocabulary/texture), three modes (rewrite/detect/ingest), named voices, protect-list seam, bilingual pattern catalogs, living corpus of dated tells. Fused from humanizer, humanize-writing, and anti-slop (MIT); lineage traces to Wikipedia's Signs of AI writing (CC BY-SA 4.0).

plugins.name: unmassk-3d
plugins.description: Reality-first CAD for 3D printing — design printable parts that fit real objects from real measurements, never invented ones. Pipeline with hard gates: capture (3D scan / spec / caliper) -> scale calibration -> parametric design as code (CadQuery/OpenSCAD) -> watertight validation (trimesh/manifold3d) -> printable STL. Blender integrated via MCP for measuring/cleaning scans and organic modelling. Printing deferred until a printer exists.

plugins.name: unmassk-electronics
plugins.description: Agent-driven electronics for makers — build, program, and verify real hardware against the device, never against hope. Multi-branch: microcontroller firmware (ESP32/RP2040/STM32 via PlatformIO, flash + serial-assert gate), Raspberry Pi / Linux SBC (SSH + gpiozero + systemd health checks), and robotics (motors/servos/sensors, sensor-gated behaviour). One rule: never report done until the device confirms it. Toolset installs only when a project is actually electronics. Wiring/soldering stays human.
